paite: Huan Hannah athum a, hichi in achi, "Ka lungtang TOUPA tung ah akipak mahmah, TOUPA ah ka kii pahtawi in a-om. Ka melmate tung ah ka kam letsak in a-om; na hotdamna a ka kipah mahmah ziak in.
heading: Hannah Thumna
english: Hannah prayed, and said, “My heart exults in Yahweh! My horn is exalted in Yahweh. My mouth is enlarged over my enemies, because I rejoice in your salvation.

paite: TOUPA bang a siangthou a-om kei uh: Nang bang mahmah lah a-om ngal kei uh. I Pathian bang suangpi himhim leng a-om sam kei.
english: There is no one as holy as Yahweh, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.

paite: Huchi tel a kisathei in thu gen nawn kei unla; na kam ua pan pau uang himhim pawt kei hen. TOUPA lah pilna Pathian ahi ngal a, ama'n thilhihte hoihtak in abuk zel hi.
english: “Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let arrogance come out of your mouth, for Yahweh is a God of knowledge. By him actions are weighed.

paite: Mihat thalpeute akitansak a, akisuite taihatna a gak in a-om hi.
english: “The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.

paite: Niang leh tai a omte nek ding zong in alohtawm ua, gilkialte kial nawn lou uhi. Achiingnu'n ta sagih aneita a, ta tampi neinu abahta hi.
english: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne seven. She who has many children languishes.

paite: TOUPA'N athat a, ahingsak hi. Han ah apaisuksak a, apikhetou hi.
english: “Yahweh kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.

paite: TOUPA'N azawngsak a, ahausasak a, ahihniam a, ahihsang hi.
english: Yahweh makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.

paite: Leivui a pan azawngte adingtousak a, ekvu a pan khutdohte adomtou hi. Miliante kiang a a-omsak theih a, thupina laltutphah atantheihna ding un. Lei kingaknate TOUPA a ahi a, ama'n atung uah khovel angata ngal a.
english: He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and inherit the throne of glory. For the pillars of the earth are Yahweh’s. He has set the world on them.

paite: Amisiangthoute khe akem ding a, migiloute bel mial lak ah daihsak in a-om ding uh. Hatna a kuamah in zou lou ding ahi ngal a.
english: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by strength.

paite: TOUPA melmate a i tamgawp ding ua, van a pan vanpiging bang in amaute adou ding. TOUPA'N kawlmong pha in vai ahawm ding a; akumpipa kiang ah hatna ape dia, athaunilhpa kii apahtawi ding," achi hi.
english: Those who strive with Yahweh shall be broken to pieces. He will thunder against them in the sky. “Yahweh will judge the ends of the earth. He will give strength to his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.”

paite: Huchi in Ramah ah a-inn ah Elkanah apaita hi. Huchi in naupang in siampu Eli ma ah TOUPA nna asemta hi.
english: Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served Yahweh before Eli the priest.

paite: Eli tapate Belial tapate ahi ua; TOUPA athei kei uh.
heading: Eli Tapate
english: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn’t know Yahweh.

paite: Mite lak a siampute hihdan ngeina ahihleh mi'n kithoihna ahong lat chiang un, sa huan laitak in siampu sikha sa thukna sikkhut zum thum nei tawi in ahong pai zel hi.
english: The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand;

paite: Belgongza hiam, belgong nei hiam, bel khaina nei hiam, bel hiam sung asunsuk a, huai sa thukna zum in ahon thukkhiak tengteng siampu in ala zel hi. Huchibang in Israel mi huai a hong pai tengteng a pan Shiloh ah ana hihsak zel uhi.
english: and he stabbed it into the pan, or kettle, or cauldron, or pot. The priest took all that the fork brought up for himself. They did this to all the Israelites who came there to Shiloh.

paite: Huai ban ah, thau akhul ma un siampu sikha ahong pai a, kithoihmi kiang ah, "Siampu a ding haimin ding sa hon pia in. Na sa huanmin adeih kei, asial adeih hi," achi hi.
english: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”

paite: Mi'n akiang ah, "Athau pen khul phot uhenla, huai khit chiang in na hinna in adeih zahzah na la ding," ana chih chiang un ama'n, "Hilou e, tu mah a na hon piak pah ding ahi. N'on piak keileh thagum in ka la ding," achi hi.
english: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh in tangvalte khelhna athupi mahmah a, mite'n lah TOUPA kiang a kithoihna lat thilkihhuai in angaita uhi.
english: The sin of the young men was very great before Yahweh; for the men despised Yahweh’s offering.

paite: Himahleh Samuel in bel naupang chik in, puanmalngat siampu puanak silh in TOUPA ma ah nna asem hi.
heading: Shiloh Ah Samuel
english: But Samuel ministered before Yahweh, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod.

paite: Huai lou leng anu'n puanaktual neu akhuisak a, kum teng kithoihna uh lan dia apasal toh ahoh chiang un kum teng in atawisak zel hi.
english: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

paite: Eli in Elkanah leh azi avualzawl a, "TOUPA a dia na thillat uh mun luah ding numei suan TOUPA'N hon pia hen," achi hi. Huchi in a-inn uah apaita uhi.
english: Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, “May Yahweh give you offspring from this woman for the petition which was asked of Yahweh.” Then they went to their own home.

paite: TOUPA'N Hannah aveh a, nau apai a, tapa thum leh tanu nih anei hi. TOUPA ma ah naupang Samuel ahong khanglianta hi.
english: Yahweh visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before Yahweh.

paite: Eli bel atek mahmahta hi. Israel mi tengteng tung a atapate thilhih tengteng leh kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak bul a nasem numeite ana kithuahpih zel thute uh aza hi.
heading: Eli Leh Atapate
english: Now Eli was very old; and he heard all that his sons did to all Israel, and how that they slept with the women who served at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huchi in akiang uah, "Bangziak a hichibang thilhih na mai ua? Hiai mi tengteng a pan na thilhihdan hoihloute uh ka na za ngal a.
english: He said to them, “Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.

paite: Hichi ding hilou ahi, ka tapate aw, na tanchin uh ka zak ahoih lou lam ngen ahi. TOUPA mite na taleksak uhi.
english: No, my sons; for it is not a good report that I hear! You make Yahweh’s people disobey.

paite: Mi khat, midang tung a akhelhleh Pathian in vai ahawmsak ding hi. Himahleh TOUPA tung a mi akhelhleh kua'n amah a ding in angetsakta dia?" achi hi. Huchi pipi in leng apa uh aw angaikhe kei ua, ToUPA'n amaute athah ding ziak in.
english: If one man sins against another, God will judge him; but if a man sins against Yahweh, who will intercede for him?” Notwithstanding, they didn’t listen to the voice of their father, because Yahweh intended to kill them.

paite: Naupang Samuel akhanglian deuhdeuh a; Pathian leh mihing deihsak in a-om hi.
english: The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with Yahweh and also with men.

paite: Eli kiang ah Pathian mipa khat ahong a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Aigupta gam a Pharaoh inn a na om lai un na pa inkote kiang ah ka kilak kei maw?
heading: Eli Inkuan Tungtang Genkholhna
english: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Did I reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?

paite: Israel nam tengteng lak a pan ka siampu hi ding, ka maitam a thil lan ding, gimlim hal ding leh siampu puanak silh dia amah ka tel ahi kei maw? Na pa inkote kiang ah Israel mite halmang thillat teng ka pia ahi kei maw?
english: Didn’t I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? Didn’t I give to the house of your father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?

paite: Bangziak in ahia ka tenna a na lat ding ua ka thupiak ka kiang a kithoihna leh kei a tuam dia thillat pen lei toh sikden a, kei sang a na tapate na zahtak zawk a, noumau na kisukthauna ding ua ka mi Israelte kithoihna ahoihpente na zat uh?'
english: Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation, and honor your sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel my people?’

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA Israelte' Pathian in, 'Ke'n zaw na inkote leh na pa inkote tangtawn in ka ma ah na om ding uh,' ka na chi ngei hi. Himahleh tu in TOUPA'N, 'Na om het kei ding uh. Hon zahtak peuhmah ka zahtak dia, hon musit peuhmah ka musit ding,' achi hi.
english: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk before me forever.’ But now Yahweh says, ‘Far be it from me; for those who honor me I will honor, and those who despise me will be cursed.

paite: Ngai in, 'na bante leh na pa inkote bante ka tankhiak ni ahong tung, na inn ah tekkun a dam a-om kei ding uh.
english: Behold, the days come that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father’s house, that there will not be an old man in your house.

paite: Ka tenna inn ah, Pathian in Israel hauhsakna apiak teng ah melma na mu dia, tangtawn in na inn ah tekkun a dam a-om kei ding uh.
english: You will see the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which I will give Israel. There shall not be an old man in your house forever.

paite: Ka maitam a pan ka hihman louh ding na mi pen na mit hihkhamtu leh na lungsim lungkhamsaktu ahi ding. Na inn a hong piang peuhmah adawnsih zel ding uhi.
english: The man of yours whom I don’t cut off from my altar will consume your eyes and grieve your heart. All the increase of your house will die in the flower of their age.

paite: Hiai, na tapate nih Hophni leh Phinehas tung a thil tung ding nang a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding. Ni khat in anih un asi tuaktuak ding uhi.
english: This will be the sign to you that will come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they will both die.

paite: Kei a ding in siampu muanhuai ka dingkhesak dia, huai in ka lungtang leh ka lungsim toh kituak in nna asem ding. Inkuan kiptak in ka lamsak dia, tangtawn in ka thaunilhmi ma ah a-om ding.
english: I will raise up a faithful priest for myself who will do according to that which is in my heart and in my mind. I will build him a sure house. He will walk before my anointed forever.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, na inn a om lai tengteng dangka leh tanghou ngen in akiang ah akuan ding ua, tanghou tawmchik bek nek ding ka muhtheihna ding un siampu nna khat bek hon semsak ve aw, chi in ka hong thum hi, achi ding uh," achi hi.
english: It will happen that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread, and will say, “Please put me into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a morsel of bread.”’”
